gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Swaggering and loose, Revalia strides across its widely separated letters. Noto Sans Mahajani keeps its lowercase standing tall against the capitals, and that wide funnel in the e is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Revalia shouts in bold, expressive display letters with an open-curled g. Noto Sans Malayalam then settles into a texture where the middle of each line dominates, with generously opened s bends that keep paragraphs moving.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Big and bouncy, Revalia spreads its widely separated letters out with a relaxed stride and a g that curls open. Noto Sans Marchen then lets proud, clear-curved lowercase carry the text.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Revalia brings bold, expressive display shapes, from its open-curved g to the tall band of short-stalked letters. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek wins with large lowercase eyes and gapped rounds.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-mro: A loosely striding, wide-spaced display face, Revalia has an open-bottomed g. Noto Sans Mro forms dense, tall-looking words, yet large entrances into each letter keep the going easy over paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-multani: Noto Sans Multani reads lofty and modern, with a wide gap at the e's terminal. And Revalia lays down relaxed, widely spaced display letters, a loud counterpoint to the tall, quiet text.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Expressive from the first glyph, Revalia sprawls across widely separated letters with a g whose lower curve stays open. Noto Sans Ogham does the quieter job: tall, bold-looking lowercase, gapped e.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Noto Sans Ol Chiki reads in solid blocks, never jagged skylines. Revalia does the shouting, with a bold, relaxed stride, while the body font keeps its curve tails held well back.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-old-hungaria: Noto Sans Old Hungarian has large counters in tall a, e and s. Against the loud swagger of Revalia, apertures that stay open at tiny sizes make the pairing's sharpest quality.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-old-permic: Loud, loose and expressive, Revalia strides through widely separated letters. Noto Sans Old Permic rounds its forms yet keeps them open to the side, and its lowercase nearly matches the capitals in height.
